title: Austin's Legal Battles & Land Deals
summary:
*   City leaders received legal advice regarding two significant lawsuits, including one filed by the Austin Black Contractors Association.
*   Discussions covered legal issues related to properties near the 504.9 contour line, impacting land use and development.
*   Legal counsel was sought on new agreements with school districts and a proposed lease with the Austin Hospital Authority.

EXECUTIVE SESSION
The City Council will announce it will go into Executive Session, if necessary, pursuant
to Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code, to receive advice from Legal Counsel to
discuss matters of land acquisition, litigation and personnel matters as specifically
listed on the meeting agenda. Council would take any subsequent action in the open meeting
as listed on the agenda. The City Council may also announce it will go into Executive
Session, if necessary, to receive advice from Legal Counsel regarding any other item
listed on the agenda.
EXECUTIVE SESSION (continued)
Advice from Counsel Section 551.071
-
1. Discuss Austin Black Contractors Association, Inc. v. City of Austin, Cause No.
94-CA-269-SS, U.S. District Court, Western District.
2. Discuss Philip Gutierrez, et al v. Mobil Oil Corp., et al; Cause No. 92-04889.
3. Discuss legal issues related to properties located within the 504.9 contour line.
4. Seek legal advice regarding School District Development Agreements.
5. Seek legal advice on proposed lease agreement with the Austin Hospital Authority.
